hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI RAM kernel FIT
inputs.revision: EmberBSD kernel source 9f924deb563df7d4cdbe40ab9e5caa61435cd004 plus published Wi-Fi AUTH diagnostics 535d3bd0efab37706429932cb6f15d118969ec9c

inputs.name: Static RAM root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the RAM ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser mode and attempt SAE with PMF required using the configured transition-network profile.
expected: The selected candidate is submitted to the vendor join path, completes SAE authentication and association with PMF, then receives an IP address and exchanges data.
observed: The normal multiuser RAM boot reached the shell without the earlier null-callback panic. The AUTH request arrived from SCAN; SAE candidate selection validated, the join was queued and dequeued in the current generation, and the vendor ext_connect call returned 0. The trace reported vendor Wi-Fi auth mode WIFI_AUTH_WPA3_PSK (value 6), PMF capability and requirement bits both set, and PWE configuration 0 mapped to internal mode 2. The vendor then reported disconnect reason 210 NO_AP_FOUND_W_COMPATIBLE_SECURITY. No completed authentication or association, IPv4 address, or data exchange followed.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.

Local SAE selection and a successful vendor connect-call return do not prove that an authentication frame was exchanged over the air. Reason 210 reports a security-compatibility rejection but does not identify the specific vendor check or establish its position relative to SAE.
No completed WPA3/SAE/PMF authentication or association, IPv4 address or data exchange was observed.
WPA2-only authentication, DHCP, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
